name: CSL Finance
why: Record quarterly sales, annual sales, annual profit
Latest quarter Jun 2026: Good (sales +19% YoY, profit +5% YoY)
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) raised holding by 2.1 pts in a year
New mutual fund / DII entry: 1.0% to 3.1% in a year
Promoters raised their stake by 1.6 pts in a year
Sector cycle: Earnings improving but price not confirming
risks: Latest concall: management tone cautious (headwinds / delays mentioned)
Micro cap (Rs 498 Cr): thin trading, higher risk - keep the position small
Weak cash conversion: operating cash flow only -130% of 3-year profit

guidance: Growth is expected in the SME retail book in FY27 as well and we expect to do better as the operating environment becomes more conducive.
 We expect SME retail, which fell short of our growth ambitions in FY26, to return to normalcy in the coming year as the operating environment gradually improves.
risks: Please note that any forward-looking statement made during this call should be considered in conjunction with the risks and uncertainties that we face.
These risks and uncertainties have been outlined in our Annual Reports.
focus: Page 3 of 10 I would now also like to highlight our increased focus on off-book AUM in the wholesale segment where we have started actively pursuing joint lending structures with select industry partners.
30 crore NCD issue which further diversifies our funding pool and increases access to debt capital markets.
Our lender base now stands at 36 comprising a well-diversified mix of public sector banks, private banks, small finance banks and NBFCs.
